name: Legacy Knowledge Recovery
description: Reconstructs engineering knowledge (requirements, architecture, business rules) that legacy systems never documented or have since lost, from source code, historical records, and operational history — the capability CR-087's review found no seeded Template had a real producer for.

checklists.name: Legacy Knowledge Recovery Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for knowledge reconstructed from legacy artefacts before it's trusted as a basis for modernisation decisions.

items.statement: Every reconstructed knowledge item cites the legacy artefact(s), historical record, or operational history it was derived from.
Reconstructed business rules and behaviour have been cross-checked against the legacy system's actual observed behaviour, not inferred from code alone.
Gaps where no reliable source could confirm the reconstructed knowledge are explicitly flagged, not silently filled in.

reviewGates.name: Legacy Knowledge Recovery Review
reviewGates.statement: The reconstructed knowledge has been reviewed and accepted as an accurate, provenanced basis for modernisation decisions.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the reconstructed knowledge accurate, properly sourced, and honest about what couldn't be confirmed?

obligationDefinitions.title: Knowledge reconstructed from legacy systems must be validated against a subject-matter expert before being trusted
obligationDefinitions.description: Reconstructed requirements, architecture, or business rules recovered from undocumented legacy systems are inferences, not certainties, until a subject-matter expert confirms them; recovered Knowledge must carry a validation step, not be promoted as fact on inference alone.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every recovered Knowledge item has a recorded subject-matter-expert validation before being promoted for reuse.

requiredEvidence.title: SME validation record
requiredEvidence.description: Record of subject-matter-expert review and confirmation of recovered knowledge.
requiredEvidence.collectionMethod: Manual SME review, recorded against each recovered Knowledge item.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has a subject-matter expert validated this recovered Knowledge item?
